notes: Adds animated pinball runway lights, rotating portal effects, reactor radar, impact flashes, sparks, floating points, moving targets and plunger, gentle hit feedback, rolling-ball foley and metallic rail sounds. Effects are bounded and respect reduced motion. Pool balls in new matches are 50% larger with clearer upright numbers, matching collision radius, rack spacing and aiming guides. Compact pool play hides the extra controls to enlarge the table; tap a target ball and pocket and pull the cue or power rail to shoot, or show controls for the original menus. Adds distinct original cue, ball, cushion and pocket sounds, a victory fanfare and five-second fireworks/confetti for arcade wins. Volume and mute settings are respected. Existing pool matches retain their previous ball size and rules; start a new match after updating every phone to use the larger balls. Saves, rooms, characters and rankings are retained.
